outcome: Birth-related experiences of success and failure
Maternal mental well-being (implied as a reason for study, not directly measured as an outcome here)
cohort: The study included 113 Finnish participants whose birth experiences were gathered in a survey.
finding: Postpartum people categorize aspects of their birth experiences in terms of success and failure, with primiparous people more often expressing experiences of failure compared to multiparous people.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was identified as one of the most typical expressions of success in birth experiences.
